memory: Thank you for your feedback, Michael. I've passed along your highlights to the team, and we're glad to hear you're enjoying your coffee beans and espresso machine. As for areas for improvement, please let me know if there's anything specific you'd like to see changed or if there are any concerns you have. We're always looking for ways to enhance your experience. If you have any other questions or need further assistance, feel free to ask. Enjoy your Coffee Club benefits!
